title: fleet_backup_pull.py powermeter manifest (_powermeter/manifest.json)
description: Persisted at <power_dir>/manifest.json (tools/fleet_backup_pull.py::save_power_manifest, US2), atomic write. power_dir is either <product>/<serial>/_powermeter/ (nested under an existing config-backup instrument folder) or standalone powermeter/<system_serial>/ — see resolve_power_dir; that choice is pinned in `location` and never revisited. The kind field guards against ever loading a config-backup manifest.json (manifest.schema.json) by mistake, since both are named manifest.json but live in different folders. An unreadable file, a wrong kind, or a schema_version other than 1 is rebuilt from records/*.json on disk (rebuild_power_manifest_from_disk) rather than failing the run.

kind.description: distinguishes this file from a config-backup manifest.json (manifest.schema.json) — both files share the same filename in different folders

system_serial.description: the PicoQuant instrument this power meter measured, or the literal "unknown" if the backend row had none

location.description: which tree this _powermeter folder lives under — resolved once by resolve_power_dir and pinned here; never recomputed on a later run even if a matching instrument folder later appears or disappears

updated_utc.description: when the last run that touched this folder finished

records.description: every archived power/laser measurement record for this system, any order

id.description: backend telemetry record id — the dedupe key. Null only for an entry reconstructed by rebuild_power_manifest_from_disk from a records/*.json file that turned out to have no id of its own.

received_at.description: when the backend received this record — the ordering key within one measurement_type

measured_at.description: when the power meter actually took the measurement, per the submitting app; preferred over received_at for the record filename when present

measurement_type.description: e.g. "combiner_power" — groups records for the <measurement_type>.latest.json mirror

instrument_serial.description: the power-meter DEVICE's own serial (e.g. a Thorlabs PM100USB serial) — distinct from system_serial, the PicoQuant instrument being measured. Null if the backend row omitted it.

system_serial.description: the PicoQuant instrument this measurement is about — same concept as the manifest's own system_serial, repeated per-record since records may in principle span systems

record_file.description: POSIX path of this record's records/*.json file, relative to the _powermeter folder

content_sha256.description: sha256 of the stored JSON bytes themselves — this archive's own integrity reference, since the backend issues no content hash for a telemetry record the way it does for a config backup

is_latest.description: true for the newest received_at of this measurement_type — the one also mirrored at <measurement_type>.latest.json

archived_utc.description: when this archive run wrote this entry — distinct from received_at (backend receipt) and measured_at (device measurement time); three different clocks
